messages:
Rina (People Ops): Thinking about a 2-week "Spotlight Pop-up" for June: small kiosk in SF lobby with sticker packs, handwritten notes station, and 10 "instant micro-spot" vouchers per day to hand out. Purpose: surprise + delight and drive peer-to-peer recognition. Thoughts? :confetti_ball:
Omar (Events): Love it. Quick Q: footprint? We can do a 6ft table + backdrop. Need power for label printer and lights. Can we host it during weekday lunches to maximize traffic?
Kai (Office Ops): Table OK in SF Lobby B using the north wall. I can reserve power strip. Need approvals for giveaways (swag inventory) and waste/disposal plan for stickers/packaging.
Priya (Finance): Giveaways under $50/person are fine. For budget, estimate: stickers $250, printed cards $120, vendor table & backdrop rental $400, label printer rental $80/week, incidentals $150. Total ~ $1.0k. Also need an expense code for "Culture Events".
Noah (Legal): A few notes: if we collect names for prizes, need opt-in language and retention policy. If vouchers are redeemable for a physical item, ensure terms include one-per-person and expiry. I can draft simple T&Cs.
Rina (People Ops): For the vouchers I'm imagining QR codes we can generate and redeem at the kiosk. Redeem-by date 6/30. Also want to include remote staff: will send a digital sticker pack + virtual voucher DM.
l10n-bot: Reminder: translate digital sticker pack into ES/FR/DE. File: https://drive.internal/culture/stickers/pack_v1.csv
Omar (Events): Vendor suggestion: PopUpCo will do setup + teardown and can print on-site name cards for the handwritten notes. Lead time 10 days. They quoted $560 for 2 days setup/teardown + $35/hr for onsite staffing.
Priya (Finance): Approve vendor spend pending PO. We should cap voucher redemptions: propose 70 vouchers total for SF pilot (10/day weekdays x 7 days) and 30 for remote. Keep track in a shared sheet.
Rina (People Ops): Good call. I'll create a redemptions sheet and a short form for recipients to optionally leave a message. @Noah please share T&Cs by EOD Friday. @Kai please confirm exact plug locations and whether we need a floor anchoring permit.
Kai (Office Ops): Confirmed power points at Lobby B north wall (2x). No floor anchoring needed for a table. Fire marshal OK with temporary backdrop under 6ft.
Noah (Legal): Drafted basic T&Cs: one voucher per person, expires 2026-06-30, vendor indemnity in contract. Uploading to drive now: https://drive.internal/legal/culture_tcs_1948001111.pdf
Rina (People Ops): I'll schedule the pop-up for June 9-20, 11:30-1:30 weekday lunches. Will we need volunteers? I can set up a volunteer sheet. Planner note: keep each shift 2 people.
Omar (Events): I'll book PopUpCo for June 8 setup and June 20 teardown. Can demo the mini printer and voucher flow if folks want a walk-through.
Priya (Finance): Create PO to PopUpCo for $640 and assign expense code CULT-OPS-2026. I'll also set petty cash for incidental spend ($150).
Rina (People Ops): Remote plan: send digital sticker pack + 1 virtual voucher (redeem for e-gift card) via Slack DM the morning of June 9. I'll coordinate translations with l10n-bot.
l10n-bot: Translations queued: ES/FR/DE. ETA 48h.
Kai (Office Ops): I'll coordinate pickup/storage for printed sticker packs and cards. Recommend locked storage cabinet A3.
Rina (People Ops): Volunteer ask: need 12 volunteer shifts across two weeks. I'll post sign-up in #people-ops and the weekly calendar invite. Can someone post a quick blurb to #general when we launch? :megaphone:
Omar (Events): I'll draft the blurb and share for review. Also suggest adding a Polaroid wall photo moment for people to take pictures of their cards.
Priya (Finance): Final note: keep receipts and upload to Concur within 7 days of event. Approving the pilot budget now.
Rina (People Ops): Great team 29 will follow up with sign-ups, PO number, and the shared redemption sheet link. Thanks all! :sparkles:
